own_solution.law: For a series RLC circuit, Z = R + i(ωL − 1/(ωC)) and |φ| = atan(|ωL − 1/(ωC)|/R). With ω = 2π(500) rad/s, XL = 78.5398 Ω, XC = 53.0516 Ω and X = 25.4882 Ω. An extra series resistance q replaces R by R + q.
assumptions: The stated ideal components and steady sinusoidal operation apply.
The battery-powered fan circuit is electrically separate from the RLC circuit.

notes: All certified answers agree with the impedance calculation: added series resistances of 6.5, 14 and 27 Ω give 34.9268°, 30.0827° and 24.0923°, respectively. Source amplitude cancels for every listed positive voltage. Fan resistance and resistance present only during an earlier run have no effect on the measured steady-state phase.
